title: The Clock and the Rain
style: Deep house with new age textures; dark plate reverb; soft four-on-the-floor kick, warm sub bass, muted glass bells, slow ambient pads, rain-on-window percussion and quiet clock ticks; intimate female and male leads in a high, light upper register with crooning legato phrasing, trading lines then overlapping in the chorus, with a spoken bridge over a dropped kick; 120 BPM, unhurried four-on-the-floor pulse, ending on rain, clock and breath.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Rain on Glass, Clock Tick]

[female:]
Don’t think about her.
[male:]
You said her name.

[Verse 1]
[female:]
If we go out, we might not make it.
There’s no one close enough to call.
You say Ámila’s safe somewhere.
How can you tell behind these walls?

[male:]
Are we fighting?
[female:]
I’m just scared.
[male:]
For her or us?
[female:]
For all three.

[Pre-Chorus]
[female:]
I used to tell you everything.
Then you got close to her.
Now every time you look at me,
I wonder what you see.

[Chorus]
[female:]
Goodnight, goodnight.
Stay here till it’s light.
I can hear the clock.
I can hear the rain.
[male:]
I can hear you breathe
When you turn away.

[female:]
Goodnight, goodnight.
[male:]
I’m still wide awake.

[Instrumental Drop]
[Glass Bell Motif, Rain Percussion]

[Verse 2]
[female:]
Five years, I thought I knew your eyes.
I knew that look across a room.
Three days with nothing much but rain,
And I can’t tell what’s true with you.

[male:]
I’m scared you’ll close them if I ask.
I’m scared I’ll guess and get it wrong.
I wish I’d left your sister be.
I’ve wanted you for so damn long.

[Breakdown]
[Spoken Dialogue, Kick Drops Out]

[male:]
I love you, Eneli.

[female:]
I love you too.
I wish that made it easier.

We should try to sleep.
We can look for a way out tomorrow.

[Final Chorus]
[male:]
Goodnight, goodnight.
Stay here till it’s light.
I can hear the clock.
I can hear the rain.
[female:]
I can hear you breathe.
Stay that close to me.

[male:]
Goodnight, goodnight.
[female:]
I’m still wide awake.

[Outro]
[Rain, Clock Tick, Barely Audible Breathing]

[female:]
The teddy bears stare from across the room.
The curls on the wallpaper blur.
Your shoulder settles against mine.

Goodnight, Idemó.
